properties.notes: Urban infill through redevelopment of former cinema site that is now vacant following clearance. Previous proposal for redevelopment of site for 20 apartments permitted but lapsed (10/B/0099). The latest application involves construction of a hotel (C1) with associated uses (A3/A4) and was approved in 2016 (16/01675/FUL). Identified yield reflects a relatively high density scheme for apartments in a town centre location.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
